name: Boltz
notes: Known from one roleplay served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/boltz-check-this-roleplay-out-tell-me-what-you-think-1998-09-20.html: "The Extreme I.C.O.N.", a 245-to-265-pound member of the stable SoV in the JPW, formerly half of its tag champions, who is interviewed in Lowell by Jason Lives and trades insults with Ashikari "Mystic Warrior" and Peter Damien before War Gamez. The held boltz-rspwf (GSWP 1999) shares the name; no tie.
caption: The loud JPW "I.C.O.N." of the SoV, September 1998.
